en.html:
...Fudaraku Fortress.

Fudaraku names one of the Pure Lands in the Buddhist view of the universe.

Rokuhara was deeply devoted to Buddhism, particularly the Tenryuuji branch of Rinzai Zen. Such a name suited it. Arriving at this Pure Land, however, had apparently required a quarrel over the spelling.

It was not even five years since completion. So, yes, an undefeated record with a rather short examination period. Say that, and the discussion could end there. But the sheer presence of the place really could make a man lose interest in attacking it.

How much actual strength, how much threatening appearance only? Sevastopol or Goryoukaku? Depending on the direction politics took, that question might yet receive a practical examination.

en.html:
Prince Maidono"Raichou Imagawa, the Oyumi Kubo... These days he's running here, running there, desperate to get the shogunate's leadership into his hands."
Prince Maidono"But pedigree alone won't do the whole job, bhai. By blood, first among the Four Kubo. The other three aren't such obliging fellows that they'll say, 'Very nice family tree, please take the government.'"
Prince Maidono"In the end, the elder, Doushin Yusa, became Kuniuji's guardian. Raichou was pushed into second place. So, now..."
Prince Maidono"We help Raichou. In exchange, our own political position improves. We give him the push up to Regent of Rokuhara..."
Prince Maidono"Put the Imperial Court's halo behind his head. Do certain jobs for him that are awkward to do from inside the shogunate."
Prince Maidono"Yes, jobs. That part, Kageaki, Ichijou—that is where you two come in."
Prince Maidono"Doushin is the thorn in Raichou's high-born backside. But if he starts trouble himself, everyone will know at once."
Prince Maidono"So we do it. Get inside Fudaraku Fortress and cause an incident that knocks the authority out from under Doushin Yusa."
Prince Maidono"Raichou's people will help you in..."
Prince Maidono"Details, I leave to you. Bas, don't overdo it. We want to control the shogunate."
Prince Maidono"Break the whole thing and what have we gained? Don't forget the other enemy either—the occupation army."

ja.html:
舞殿宮「小弓公方、今川雷蝶……。 　この男が今、幕府の主導権を握りたがって あくせくしてるんやけど」
舞殿宮「そうは問屋が卸さん。 　血筋からいえば四公方の筆頭やけどな…… それだけで納得するほど他の三人は甘くない」
舞殿宮「結局、邦氏の後見には長老格の遊佐童心が 立てられて、雷蝶は風下にやられてもうた。 　そこで……な」
舞殿宮「この雷蝶に力を貸す。 　こっちの政治的地位の向上と引き換えにな。 六波羅の執権に押し上げてやるんや……」
舞殿宮「朝廷の権威で後光をつけてやったり。 　幕府の内側にいたらやりにくい仕事・・を代行 してやったりしてな」
舞殿宮「そや。仕事や……。 　それを景明くんと一条さんには頼みたい」
舞殿宮「今の雷蝶には童心が目の上の瘤こぶ。 　しゃあけど自分でちょっかい・・・・・かけたらすぐ バレてまうわ」
舞殿宮「そこでうちらが手を出す。 　遊佐童心の権威が失墜するような事件を、 普陀楽城に潜入して引き起こしてやるんよ」
舞殿宮「手引きは雷蝶の配下がしてくれる……」
舞殿宮「具体的なとこは任せるわ。 　けど、やり過ぎないように気ぃつけてな。 幕府を操るのがこっちの目的なんやから」
舞殿宮「潰してもうたら元も子もない……。 　進駐軍っちゅうもう一つの敵がおることも 忘れんといてな」

en.html:
The same could be said for anyone attacking this fortress.

No—perhaps that was exactly why they had chosen asphalt, and not concrete.

Concrete paving lasts longer. It could take even heavy tanks of over fifty tons. Asphalt under such traffic cannot avoid surface damage.

But asphalt is easy to deal with. If the enemy might use the road, break it; when your own side needs it, lay it again. A road with an on-off switch is not impossible.

Apne aaye toh sadak, dushman aaye toh khadda. For our fellows, a road. For the enemy, a hole. Such discrimination in public works. The engineer must build something easy to destroy, then kindly return and build it properly again. A very fine road: it does not merely take our soldiers to work, it keeps producing work for the road-builders also.

...Provided, of course, that cost is ignored. Whether anyone would really go that far, I could not say.

ja.html:
この城へ攻め込む者にとっても同じ事が言えるが。
　いや、だからこそのアスファルト舗装なのかもしれ
なかった。コンクリートではなく。

　コンクリート舗装の方が耐久性は高い。
　五〇トン超の重戦車の走行にも耐えられるだろう。
これがアスファルトだと、路面の損傷は避けられない。

　しかしアスファルトは処理が容易である。
　敵に使われかねない場合は破壊し、自軍が使う時に
また敷設、という腰の軽い運用も不可能ではない。

　……尤も、それもコストを度外視すればの話だ。
　実際にそこまでするものかは未知数だった。

en.html:
Iwata"All cars used here are domestically made. Expensive, certainly. But a public official must have the correct taste."
Kageaki"Entirely agreed. Without that attitude, how will domestic industry develop? ...You are Lieutenant General Imagawa's—?"
Iwata"Careless, Mr. Minato. Extremely careless. Do not casually use that name here. I am posing as an ordinary official with no connection to Oyumi, while secretly conducting espionage."
Kageaki"You certainly do not give that impression."
Iwata"Heh-heh... naturally. If I gave the impression of being a spy, how could I do the work?"
Ichijou"Minato sir. I think our meaning has gone somewhere else entirely."
Kageaki"That is my impression also."
Iwata"Now, please come. Your quarters first."

ja.html:
岩田「この城で使われている車は全て国産ですよ。 　値は張りますが、それが公人の嗜みという ものですからね」
景明「全く同意できます。その姿勢なくして国内 産業の育成は成し得ません。 　……貴方が、今川中将閣下の？」
岩田「無用心ですよ、湊斗様。ここで迂闊にその 名前を口になさいますな。 　私は表向き小弓とは何の関係もない一介の 役人を装い、密偵スパイ活動をしているのですから」
景明「とてもそうは見えませんが」
岩田「ふふふ……当然でしょう。 　そうでなくては密偵など務まりませんもの」
一条「湊斗さん。 　話が通じてないような気が」
景明「俺もそう思う」
岩田「さ、どうぞ。 　まずは官舎へご案内します」
